clinical_significance: Levels <30 ng/mL cause severe postpartum fatigue, telogen effluvium hair loss, and mood depletion even when Hemoglobin is normal.
Biphasic postpartum thyroiditis peaks between 6 weeks and 6 months postpartum; screen with Free T4 and TPOAb.
Supports maternal immune modulation, bone mineralization, and breastmilk antirachitic activity (at 4,000-6,400 IU/day maternal intake).
Screen for acute peripartum blood loss anemia; pair with reticulocyte count and serum ferritin.
Essential for infant myelination and maternal methylation; pair with serum folate.
